source_screen.method: pinned PolyAI-maintained dataset repository card/tree plus TRAIN-only parquet audit

task_fit.native_task: single-domain banking intent classification over 77 supplied intent options
task_fit.potential_value: a fine-grained practical text-only Decision task with multiclass probability output
task_fit.product_scope: English banking intent routing only; not general text reasoning or multimodal quality
task_fit.option_contract: fixed intent-ID option set; arbitrary unseen options are not established

limitations: The dataset card lists source language producers as More Information Needed and supplies no participant or conversation IDs; independent speaker/customer grouping is unverified.
Normalized utterance identity can prevent exact-content leakage but cannot establish source-person independence or near-duplicate paraphrase separation.
The task is a fixed-label, single-domain intent classifier; it does not establish arbitrary supplied-option reasoning, general text quality, or multimodal fusion.
The published test payload remains unopened and must not enter iterative training, model selection, or calibration.
recommendation: Keep as a bounded TRAIN-only development candidate for compact BERT-family text Decision comparison after a deterministic content-grouped split is frozen. Do not make independent-source or product-quality claims until source-group provenance and the complete task protocol are resolved.
